Decoration only, conformed to the park_flume bake; rebuild after a re-bake. Procedural, authored in this repository from Blender bmesh sheets; no external mesh. No -col mesh: the stamped terrain stays the only collider. Ships a flush sandstone sheet: banded strata relief of at most 0.06 m with colour bands and varnish streaks inside the lane. Flush lane: measured exactly against the game's ground mesh, the drawn surface stands 0.03 to 0.12 m above it inside any ride row's footprint and at least 0.03 m above it everywhere; walls, lips and verges outside a footprint may stand higher. The sheet ships no rim props (no rocks, no tufts) and no detail shells. Registry class park_large (16000 triangles): cutting it to the ground mesh within that band needs more than the 8,000 triangles of landform; the park row's budget stays landform.
